name: Water heater (tank)

combustion.note: Gas and oil models only: electric tanks burn nothing. Vented to a chimney or wall vent; a blocked or loose flue spills CO. Standing-pilot gas tanks need no mains power (Resideo WT8840); power-vent and oil-fired ones do, so check for a cord or wiring. kW: one 40 US gal gas tank (A.O. Smith ProLine).

comps.spec: Screw-in heating elements, about 4.5 kW (electric models)
Magnesium anode rod — shavings make a fire starter
comps.loc: Top of the tank, large hex head

comps.spec: Gas control valve with thermocouple (gas models)

notes: A gas tank with a standing pilot keeps heating water in a power cut: a thermopile in the pilot flame powers the gas control (Resideo WT8840). Gas and oil tanks vent their exhaust through a flue; keep it connected and clear.
